defs.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical sidebar listing the home's floors and rooms (Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, Garage, etc.) with icons, per-room device counts and an 'All Rooms / Whole Home' option, plus a quick search field. Selecting a room sets the global room scope that every other panel filters by.
defs.role: It is the master scope selector of the panel, determining which room's devices, climate, energy and security data every other component displays.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On room selection (or 'All Rooms'), emit the selected roomId; the grid re-queries and renders only device tiles assigned to that room, resetting scroll and showing an empty-state if the room has no devices.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Dial
targets.description: Emits the selected roomId; the dial switches to that room's thermostat/zone, loading its current temperature, target setpoint, humidity and HVAC mode (falls back to whole-home average when 'All Rooms' is chosen).

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: Emits the selected roomId; the monitor rescopes all charts and totals to consumption attributed to that room's devices, or whole-home totals when 'All Rooms' is selected.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security & Camera Panel
targets.description: Emits the selected roomId; the panel highlights and scrolls to the cameras, door/window sensors and locks located in that room, defaulting the camera feed to that room's primary camera.

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build the central grid of device tiles (lights, plugs, fans, blinds, speakers, appliances) where each tile shows name, room, icon, live state and an inline control — toggle switch, brightness/level slider, color swatch or position control — plus a tile expand for detailed settings. This is the primary surface for directly operating individual devices.
defs.role: It is the main hands-on control surface where the user directly operates each device, scoped by the room navigator and bulk-updated by scenes and automations.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and filters the rendered device tiles to that room only (or shows all devices for 'All Rooms').

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene & Lighting Selector
effectors.description: On scene activation, receives a payload of device state targets (per-device on/off, brightness, color temperature); matching tiles animate to the new states and their toggles/sliders update to reflect the scene's values.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Automation & Routine Scheduler
effectors.description: When a routine fires or is manually run, receives the list of device actions it performs; affected tiles update their state live and display a small 'automated' badge indicating the controlling routine.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On every device state change (toggle on/off, brightness or level change), emits deviceId, new state and its estimated wattage; the monitor updates the live load figure and appends the change to the running consumption series and top-consumers list.

defs.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Dial
defs.genInstructions: Build a circular thermostat dial showing current temperature, drag-to-set target setpoint, humidity readout, HVAC mode buttons (heat/cool/auto/off), fan speed and a small daily temperature curve. It provides full climate control for the selected room or zone.
defs.role: It is the dedicated climate control station for the currently scoped room, feeding its HVAC load into the energy monitor and responding to scene presets.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and loads that zone's live temperature, humidity, setpoint and mode; shows whole-home averages for 'All Rooms'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene & Lighting Selector
effectors.description: On activation of a scene that carries climate presets (e.g. Away = eco 18°C, Night = 20°C), receives the target setpoint and HVAC mode and animates the dial to those values.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On setpoint or HVAC mode change, emits the new mode and estimated heating/cooling load; the monitor updates the HVAC slice of the consumption breakdown and the projected daily cost.

defs.name: Smart Home: Scene & Lighting Selector
defs.genInstructions: Build a row/grid of scene cards (Morning, Movie, Away, Night, Dinner) with preview colors, an activate action and an edit mode to adjust which devices and levels each scene sets. Activating a scene pushes a coordinated state change across lights and climate.
defs.role: It is the one-tap orchestration layer that applies coordinated multi-device presets, driving the device grid and thermostat in a single action.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Automation & Routine Scheduler
effectors.description: When a scheduled routine whose action is 'activate scene' triggers, receives the sceneId and activates that scene, highlighting it as currently active with the triggering routine noted.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On scene activation, emits the scene's full device state map (on/off, brightness, color temperature per deviceId); the grid applies these values to matching tiles and re-renders their controls.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Dial
targets.description: On activation of a scene containing climate settings, emits the target setpoint and HVAC mode so the dial moves to the scene's preset temperature.

defs.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
defs.genInstructions: Build an energy panel with a live wattage gauge, a time-series consumption chart with day/week/month range toggles, a breakdown donut by category (lighting, HVAC, appliances) and a top-consumers list with cost estimate. It reports how current device and climate activity translates into energy use.
defs.role: It is the analytics readout of the panel, converting the live states driven by the device grid and thermostat into consumption, cost and trend insight for the scoped room.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and rescopes the gauge, chart, breakdown and top-consumers list to that room's devices, or whole-home totals for 'All Rooms'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives device state-change events with deviceId and estimated wattage; updates the live load gauge, extends the real-time series and reorders the top-consumers list.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Dial
effectors.description: Receives setpoint/HVAC mode changes with the resulting estimated load; updates the HVAC portion of the breakdown donut and the projected daily cost figure.

defs.name: Smart Home: Security & Camera Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a security panel with a live camera feed viewer plus thumbnail strip, arm/disarm mode buttons (Home/Away/Disarmed), a door/window sensor status list, smart lock toggles and a recent events log. It covers monitoring and securing the home.
defs.role: It is the safety and surveillance station of the panel, showing and controlling locks, sensors and cameras for the scoped room and responding to scheduled security routines.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and filters sensors, locks and camera thumbnails to that room, auto-loading that room's primary camera into the main feed viewer.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Automation & Routine Scheduler
effectors.description: When a routine with a security action fires (e.g. 'Away at 09:00 arms system', 'Night locks all doors'), receives the target arm mode and lock commands; the panel switches arm state, updates lock toggles and writes an entry into the events log.

defs.name: Smart Home: Automation & Routine Scheduler
defs.genInstructions: Build a routines panel listing automations as rows with trigger (time, sunset, presence, sensor), action summary, enable/disable switch, a run-now button and an add/edit rule builder. It automates scenes, devices and security modes on schedule or condition.
defs.role: It is the time- and condition-based brain of the system, firing scenes, device actions and security modes automatically so the rest of the panel updates without manual input.

targets.name: Smart Home: Scene & Lighting Selector
targets.description: When an enabled routine fires (schedule hit or 'Run Now' pressed) with a scene action, emits the sceneId so the selector activates that scene and marks it active.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: When a routine with direct device actions fires, emits the list of deviceId/target-state pairs; the grid applies the states to those tiles and flags them with an automation badge naming the routine.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security & Camera Panel
targets.description: When a routine with a security action fires, emits the requested arm mode and lock commands; the security panel updates its arm state, lock toggles and appends the event to its log.
